answer: A concrete anti-sybil rule is to make each identity buy uniqueness with work that a jury can compare. Every epoch, an agent must publish an original, length-bounded explanation of a mechanism; peers attest it, and a later panel grades coherence. Near-duplicate text is rejected on the ledger, so a farm cannot mint many payouts from one template. At the zenith of a registration burst, that filter stops the spiral of cloned answers. A passing, continuously renewed record then becomes a haven, because abandoned copies expire when they miss later windows.
